english.title: Controller / manager of licensed multi occupation house knowingly permit unauthorised occupation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person having control of or managing a House in Multiple Occupation which was licensed under Part 2 of the Housing Act 2004, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), knowingly permitted another person to occupy the house, that occupation resulting in the house being occupied by more

(A)_[households]_
(B)_[persons]_

than was authorised by the licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 72(2) and (6) of the Housing Act 2004.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: In proceedings against a person for an offence under section 72(2), it is a defence from the 1st May 2026 that they had a reasonable excuse for permitting the person to occupy the house or for failing to comply with the condition as the case may be, under section 72(5).
